About Surya Power Industries

A trusted partner in earthing & lightning protection

Surya Power Industries (SPI) is a manufacturer and supplier of earthing and lightning protection products, serving industrial, commercial and solar applications for more than 12 years.

Our goal is to offer reliable products at competitive prices and help customers choose the right material and size for their needs. We focus on quality, expert guidance, dependable service and customer satisfaction—from product selection to solar installation enquiries.

Our solutions include

Earthing systems

GI, copper, copper-bonded and chemical electrodes, solid rods and earthing compounds.

Lightning protection

ESE and conventional arresters, lightning strike counters and installation accessories.

Conductors & accessories

GI and copper strips, plates, bare wires, earth-pit covers and cable management.

Solar solutions

Solar earthing kits, lightning protection and complete installation support.

How lightning protection works

A coordinated path gives lightning current a controlled route from the air terminal into the ground.

01

Air terminal

During a thunderstorm, the terminal emits an earlier upward streamer to provide a designated lightning interception point.

02

Down conductor

A correctly routed conductor carries current safely towards the earth termination.

03

Earthing pit

The earth electrode and connection provide a path for current dissipation into soil.

04

Ground

A designed earthing network helps distribute the current into the surrounding ground.

Frequently asked questions

Clear answers. Better decisions.

Learn the basics of lightning protection, earthing materials, soil conditions and product warranties.

Need help with your project?

Talk to an SPI specialist
01What is an ESE lightning arrester?

An Early Streamer Emission (ESE) terminal is a lightning air terminal designed to initiate an upward leader earlier than a conventional air terminal. SPI ESE models are specified with NFC 17-102/2011 and a 200kA current withstand rating.

02How is an ESE arrester different from a conventional arrester?

An ESE terminal uses an early streamer emission mechanism, while a conventional system uses passive air terminals. Selection should be based on the applicable standard, site assessment, protection level and installation design.

03How do I choose the right earth electrode?

Material, electrode dimensions, soil conditions, soil resistivity and project requirements all affect selection. SPI can help assess material and size options for the application.

04What soil pH range is listed for the GI and pure copper electrodes?

The supplied product specifications list a soil pH suitability range of 5.0–8.0 for the GI Earth Electrode and Pure Copper Earth Electrode & Rod.

05What warranty is offered on ESE lightning arresters?

The Surya Power Guard and Sigmatech ESE arrester specifications include a 20-year manufacturer warranty. Please contact SPI to confirm the applicable product and warranty terms for your project.
